title: Warning!
text: Warning!. I've had this vacuum for about a month and I loved it until this past week. Now it's almost impossible to get the cannister to lock into place. Still works great if I hold the cannister in place but then I have no free hand, which makes doing a lot of things very difficult. So at this point I'm not at all happy with it and, of course, since it's been over 30 days, I doubt I can return it.
